title: Release P007 Datum-A form, flange size, overall length, blind-end thickness and edge condition
scope: K01-P-007 primary geometric Product Definition remaining after EDR-029

C01.release_spec: DATUM A; FLATNESS 0.03 CZ across the two controlled coplanar J2 mating-face patches
C01.basis: Datum A is the functional J2 mating reference and already has a canonical composite-coplanar persistent binding. The legacy 0.03 mm candidate is promoted only after revalidation as one common/combined form zone across the actual functional contact patches, avoiding independent-surface ambiguity.
C01.inspection: CMM/common-zone plane evaluation of both controlled patches in a clean free state without clamp distortion.

C05.basis: OD33×3 is the frozen C2R1 compact-flange architecture. T05 analytical preload/thread/contact screening retains this geometry; C04 at its maximum hole size still leaves positive flange ligament. The ±0.05 size band is retained as the widest existing controlled candidate that does not require tighter manufacturing precision.
C05.inspection: OD micrometer/CMM; flange thickness by CMM or qualified thickness/depth measurement.

C06.basis: REQ-K01-P007-L-001 freezes the 35 mm C2R1 mechanical envelope. No downstream functional evidence requires a tighter band; the historical ±0.05 candidate is therefore promoted rather than replaced by a new invented value.
C06.inspection: CMM or qualified overall-length measurement from the functional Datum-A side to the external blind-end face.

K01-D006-BLIND-END.basis: The integral blind end is a containment wall, not a precision locating feature. EDR-027 T07A shows very large global static and elastic-buckling margins at the released ±0.20 bar envelope; therefore no functional basis exists for a tighter precision band. ±0.10 mm is selected as a pragmatic machining/inspection band for the deep-bore monolithic route, subject to first-article capability confirmation.
K01-D006-BLIND-END.inspection: CMM/depth difference between external end face and internal blind-bottom face, or equivalent qualified thickness method.

EDGE_CONDITION.release_spec: DEBURR; BREAK NON-FUNCTIONAL SHARP EDGES 0.1–0.2 mm. DO NOT BREAK/ABRADE DATUM A, Ø14.10 H7 LOCATOR, SEAL-CONTACT, OR OTHER EXPLICITLY CONTROLLED FUNCTIONAL EDGES UNLESS SPECIFICALLY DIMENSIONED.
EDGE_CONDITION.basis: Controls handling/manufacturing burrs without weakening or changing functional datum, fit or sealing geometry.

technical_filter.function: Preserve J2 seating, compact flange envelope, 35 mm mechanical envelope and integral containment wall while avoiding unnecessary precision.
technical_filter.manufacturing: Uses the selected monolithic 316L deep-bore/finish route; tolerances are intentionally not tightened beyond demonstrated functional need.
technical_filter.assembly: Retains frozen C2R1 OD33×3 / 3×M2.5 / L35 architecture and controlled Datum-A seating.
technical_filter.inspectability: All released characteristics have direct CMM/micrometer/depth inspection routes; thin-wall/blind-end capability remains first-article evidence.
technical_filter.calculation_evidence: WP-T05 analytical clamp/contact screen + EDR-027 T07A global pressure-shell screen + canonical CAD geometry.

standards_method_basis: Tornincasa, Technical Drawing for Product Design: functional datums; geometrical specification as a function/manufacturing/inspection language; combined-zone semantics where one functional requirement spans multiple features.
ISO GPS profile already controlled by K01 drawing standard profile.
explicit_nonclaims: EDR-030 does not close seal material, quantitative leak acceptance, fastener torque/lubrication, service cycles or surface texture on functionally sealing surfaces.
EDR-030 does not replace the final full-PMI binding-invariance qualification.
EDR-030 does not claim supplier/process capability evidence has already been collected; first-article capability remains a release verification item.
stale_triggers: C2R1 J2 geometry or Datum-A architecture changes
seal/process choice imposes a tighter functional surface/form requirement
magnetic/travel axial stack demonstrates blind-end or OAL tolerance is insufficient
first-article capability proves a released tolerance impractical and forces a design/process trade-off
